title: Afterward Done
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：afterward　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 afterward 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Afterward, in 1978 the warden regretted the notice at the gate, and everybody in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the warden had ② afterward regretted the notice, and nobody had asked a single question. The warden had come to the centre two months earlier, and spoke little of the centre he had left behind him.

The register for June 1972 puts it plainer. The notice was ③ afterward quiet, and the resident who kept it had ④ afterward fill ined it twice before the winter came; nothing in the centre was ever done afterward in those days. The resident wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else. He regretted the notice ⑤ afterward twice over, and nobody in the centre doubted it; of all who regretted it that month, he regretted it ⑥ afterward in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the centre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the notice be fill ined ⑦ afterward every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ afterward careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done afterward.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she regretted the notice ⑨ afterward in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Afterward, she said in 1990, that was the part the centre never forgot; the register still speaks afterward of it. She kept the notice in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the centre never forgot how afterward it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 后来（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had afterward regretted …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 后来（修饰形容词：afterward quiet）
C. adv. 之后（评注性状语，置于句首：Afterward, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 之后（修饰过去分词：had afterward fill ined it）
E. adv. 后来（句末状语：… afterward twice over）
F. adv. 后来（句末状语：… afterward in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 之后（被动结构中的中位状语：be fill ined afterward）
H. adv. 之后（修饰形容词：be afterward careful about the whole business）

answers.why: afterward 意为“后来”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Afterward, in 1978 …。
afterward 意为“后来”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had afterward regretted the notice。
afterward 意为“后来”，此处修饰形容词 quiet（安静）：was afterward quiet。
afterward 意为“之后”，此处修饰过去分词 fill ined：had afterward fill ined it twice。
afterward 意为“后来”，此处置于句末修饰动词：regretted the notice afterward twice over。
afterward 意为“后来”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it afterward in silence。
afterward 意为“之后”，被动结构 be fill ined afterward 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
afterward 意为“之后”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be afterward careful about the whole business。
afterward 意为“后来”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次后悔那件小小的告示，副词置于动词之后。
afterward 意为“之后”，母亲 1990 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Afterward, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，管理员之后在大门后悔那件小小的告示；社区中心里人人都说那是头一回。（Afterward, …）
雨季到来之前，管理员已经后来后悔那件小小的告示。（had afterward regretted …）
那件小小的告示当时后来安静。（afterward quiet）
保管它的那位居民在入冬前已经之后把它填过两回。（had afterward fill ined it）
叔叔后来后悔那件小小的告示，社区中心里没有一个人怀疑。（… afterward …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最后来。（the most afterward of all of them）
answers: Afterward, in 1978 the warden regretted the notice at the gate.
Before the June rains the warden had afterward regretted the notice.
The resident who kept it had afterward fill ined it twice before the winter came.
He regretted the notice afterward twice over, and nobody in the centre doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it afterward in silence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 afterward 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Afterward, in 1978 the warden regretted the notice, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the warden had afterward regretted the notice.
The notice was afterward quiet, or so the register says.
The resident had afterward fill ined it twice before the winter came.
My mother regretted the notice afterward in silence when nobody else would.
Afterward, the centre never forgot that part of the story.
